before: Embedded objects with refresh-lock metadata, and picture-form objects with any metadata text, could be omitted altogether. A disabled stroke with a standard join style could hide a cached picture.
after: Supported embedded objects in both object and picture form reserve the image bounds and display their cached image. The refresh-lock flag, field codes, and disabled stroke stay inert.
reason: Existing XML and relationship parts are preserved. No shared state, operation kind, snapshot field or protocol message changes. As with existing VML projection subsets, an inline preview occupies one local offset and a mixed-version selection may differ by one offset per newly projected object.
